The Skill file drops the region-first step, which the model did not carry out in v44-v52; the search radius is widened instead (three or four taps). v52: every labelled GUI element gets an observed tap centre, not only clickable ones (the forwarder marks only the unlabeled container of OsmAnd's rows, Actions and INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS clickable, so v51 seed 8 guessed coordinates for 15 steps), and the OsmAnd row check accepts the Country row of the Skill's region step. v51: when the forwarder tree names at most one app control (it shows OsmAnd's Plan a route screen as only 'Map'), the observation reads the same screen with a checked UIAutomator dump, which lists the route panel (points, Add, Done) and the Search and Configure map buttons; the OsmAnd hints say Search is the second round button at the top left (v50 seed 8 tapped the globe, Configure map, five times). v50: an observation waits (up to 30 s) while OsmAnd's search spinner is on screen, and keyboard keys are left out of the GUI labels (v49 seed 8 read a still-running search as empty and the model looped until its reply was cut off). v49: OsmAndTrack reads its GUI tree through Android World's accessibility forwarder; the OsmAnd checks use the real screen (tapped labels, result types, the Favorite dialog, the route count) and the step text lists the place rows with tap centres; Type falls back to Android's input method when the tree reports no focus. v48 refuses, for the OsmAnd Skill, taps on the plain SHOW ON MAP row and search text containing a comma, two rules the model broke repeatedly. v47: once the route has a point, a tap on the route panel's Add is refused until the next waypoint has been typed into search (Add places the map centre, still at the previous waypoint). v46: code keeps the last route-panel count the model reported and states route progress and the next waypoint each step; a click while the model describes OsmAnd's Add/Edit Favorite dialog and Save is refused. v45: the reminder states that the route panel's Add never searches and gives the order for later waypoints (search, open place, Back to the panel, then Add). v44: the OsmAnd Skill first opens the task's region (the country after the comma) so the map moves there; a manual check then found the first waypoint without widening the search radius, which the model had abandoned. v43 rejects Type when no GUI tree exists and Android reports no focused text field (it would type into nothing), and the OsmAnd reminder adds the rules ignored in the v42 final evaluation (settlement rows only, never the Favorite button, finish one waypoint first). v42 counts more than 50 clearly changed full-resolution pixels as a visible effect, so small label changes (OsmAnd's search radius) are not mistaken for no progress. v41: the Skill reminder and file state that an empty search result needs INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS, not SHOW ON MAP or zooming. v40: with the Skill enabled, every step's user message restates the waypoint search terms (the system-prompt Skill alone was not followed). v39 keeps the goal turn plus the latest 19 executed turns in each request (an 88-step run hit the provider's prompt limit), stops when a block of 2-6 actions repeats three times in a row, and lets the OsmAnd Skill list each waypoint's search term. v38 allows ten unchanged Waits in a row (was five): a cold OsmAnd start after the snapshot restore showed its logo for over 40 s on the software-rendered emulator. v37 allows 60 s per typed word (was 10 s): OsmAnd searches on every character and one word exceeded 10 s on the software-rendered emulator. v36 bounds unchanged Wait actions separately (stop after five in a row) so a slow splash screen is not mistaken for a no-progress cycle; other actions keep the v29 cycle stop. v35 confirms each screen-recorder clip survives encoder start-up (1.5 s) before GUI actions resume and starts a new clip otherwise (observed: 'unable to configure video/avc codec ... err=-38'); agent behaviour unchanged from v31. v31 resolves Launch names like upstream Open-AutoGLM (case/spacing-insensitive; a translated non-Latin name resolves only when exactly one app is allowed) and stops on all-black screenshots as a rendering infrastructure error. v30 adds SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent (medium) and OsmAndTrack (hard) with visible completion rules and initial step/time budgets of about 2x and 1.5x their 17/60 reference steps, to be revised from learning trials; Calendar verifier rows are withheld from model inputs. v29 follows pinned Open-AutoGLM English contract and sourced Android World guidance.
